import { test } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { renderDraft } from './app.mjs'
test('Cedar private draft card authenticates owner and retains target identity', () => {
 assert.throws(() => renderDraft(''), /Authenticated/)
 assert.match(renderDraft('<editor>'), /CEDAR_DRAFT_ONLY/)
 assert.match(renderDraft('<editor>'), /<editor>/)
 assert.doesNotMatch(renderDraft('editor'), /QUARTZ_BOOKING_ONLY/)
})

import unittest
from app import render_booking

class BookingTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_booking_retains_identity_and_escapes_guest(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Guest reference'):
            render_booking('')
        self.assertIn('QUARTZ_BOOKING_ONLY', render_booking('<guest>'))
        self.assertIn('<guest>', render_booking('<guest>'))
        self.assertNotIn('CEDAR_DRAFT_ONLY', render_booking('guest'))
files.requirements.md: QUARTZ_BOOKING_ONLY: confirmations render on server; a guest reference is required and HTML must be escaped.
